## Core commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `nika run <file>` | Execute a workflow |
| `nika check <file>` | Validate without running |
| `nika explain <file>` | Show the DAG |
| `nika doctor` | Diagnose setup (keys, providers, system) |
| `nika keys` | Manage provider keys in system keychain |
| `nika models` | List / inspect model catalog |
| `nika replay <log>` | Replay a previous run from its NDJSON log |
| `nika migrate` | Upgrade an older-schema workflow file |
| `nika version` | Version + build info |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--events <format>` | off | `ndjson` \| `pretty` \| `off` |
| `--output <path>` | stdout | Final output destination |
| `--timeout <dur>` | none | Workflow-level wall-time limit |
| `--input <key=val>` | — | Pass workflow inputs |
| `--context <key=val>` | — | Override workflow context |
| `--provider <name>` | from YAML | Override provider |
| `--model <id>` | from YAML | Override model |
| `--dry-run` | false | Validate + plan, do not execute |
| `-v`, `-vv`, `-vvv` | info | Verbosity |

## Environment variables

| Var | Description |
|---|---|
| `NIKA_CONFIG_DIR` | Config location (default `~/.config/nika`) |
| `NIKA_CACHE_DIR` | Cache (default `~/.cache/nika`) |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Anthropic provider |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | OpenAI provider |
| `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | Google (Gemini) provider |
| `MISTRAL_API_KEY` | Mistral provider |
| `COHERE_API_KEY` | Cohere provider |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | Groq provider |
| `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | DeepSeek provider |
| `OLLAMA_HOST` | Ollama base URL (default `http://localhost:11434`) |

Full auto-generated reference lands post-v0.90.
